health-2012-001.note: NHSBT RESTORE (Nov 2022) is a first-in-human trial; Hemopure registered only in South Africa and Russia (PMC8692657). Niche real use below 5% of transfusions = partial.

health-2012-002.note: MACI (FDA 2016) and Medicare-covered skin substitutes are routine but niche; no source found showing 5% of relevant wound or cartilage procedures by 2022 (search found none). Partial holds; least certain under a broad skin-substitute reading.

health-2012-003.note: FDA approved Humacyte Symvess Dec 2024 (FDA press release); earlier humanitarian use in Ukraine 2022. Real use within 5 years, far below 5% = partial (D37 has no miss for real use below 5%).

health-2012-009.note: Spritam FDA-approved 2015 and marketed (PharmTech); few other printed products. Real use, negligible share = partial.

health-2012-010.note: The capture reads the label as therapies using stem cells to treat disease, which includes HSCT, and D37 counts earlier use. AutoHCT reached 27.4% of US myeloma patients diagnosed 2011-2016 (PMC11624524), above 5%. Both graders excluded HSCT on an unstated forward-looking reading and said it would otherwise be a hit.

health-2012-012.note: PMC: 34% of 2022 FDA NMEs personalized, >=25% since 2015 (approvals share is a proxy). Use test is met by biomarker-selected oncology: NGS testing in 35% of advanced NSCLC by 2018-19 (Flatiron). Hit.

health-2012-023.note: JAMA Netw Open 2020: robotic share of general surgery in 73 Michigan hospitals rose 1.8% (2012) to 15.1% (2018), verified. Hit.

health-2012-024.note: PMC10337374 (July 2022, n=1,084, Germany): 6.5% had used a symptom checker; grader A misquoted 13%. 6.5% plus FDA-cleared app ECG still clears 5% by 2022, thinly. Hit, least certain.

health-2012-025.note: Harvard D3 case: Dragon Medical used by 500,000 clinicians, 90% of US hospitals, 80% of radiologists, and describes NLP-based features. Speech recognition is a narrow NLP reading but routine use is far above 5%. Hit.

health-2012-026.note: Augmedics xvision first US case June 2020 (BusinessWire); 10,000 cumulative cases by Apr 2025, tiny share of US spine surgery. Partial.

health-2012-027.note: NHS Pathways triages 16.6M NHS 111 calls a year (medRxiv 2023); RCGP paper shows majority-remote GP appointments in 2020 but does not contain grader A's 79%-of-practices figure. Hit holds on B's evidence.

health-2012-028.note: PubMed 39396601 abstract (211,346 Medicare CIED patients, 2015-2020): 14.7% had remote monitoring in first 91 days, <5% at recommended frequency; the graders' two-thirds figure is not in the abstract. Still above 5% by 2022. Hit.

health-2012-033.note: FDA safety communication 21 Feb 2024: no non-invasive glucose smartwatch or ring authorized; CE-marked GlucoTrack abandoned. No real use by 2025 = miss.

health-2012-034.note: ONC data brief verified: 38% (2020) and 57% (2022) of US individuals accessed online records or portals. Hit.

health-2012-035.note: Sibel ANNE One FDA 510(k) May 2023 (AASM); NICU evaluation PMC9246120. Pilots and early deployments, far below 5% = partial.

health-2012-036.note: Watson Health sold Jan 2022 after limited adoption (Fierce Healthcare); OpenEvidence used by >40% of US physicians by Aug 2025 (Healthcare IT Today, company figure). 5% reached 2023-2025 = partial.

health-2012-037.note: Abilify MyCite approved 2017, discontinued Oct 2024; Proteus bankrupt 2020. Capsule endoscopy fits the label and counts as earlier use, but is a small share of GI diagnostics. Partial.

health-2012-038.note: Flatiron verified: NGS in advanced NSCLC 5% (2012-13) to 35% (2018-19). Hit.

health-2012-039.note: JAMA Netw Open 2022 (survey Jan 2021, n=1,247, ages 50-80): 55% with hypertension owned and used a home BP monitor. Hit.

health-2012-040.note: PatientsLikeMe ~830,000 members, about 2% of US MS patients, bought by UnitedHealth 2019 (Wikipedia, STAT). Real use below 5% = partial.

health-2012-041.note: Eversense implantable CGM FDA June 2018 (FDA PMA P160048); CardioMEMS 2014. Loop recorders fit the label as earlier use but no source found showing 5% of a relevant population (search found none). Partial.

health-2012-046.note: HAL: 300 suits in 130 Japanese facilities (2012), EU medical CE 2013, FDA 2017 (Wikipedia). Routine niche use = partial.

health-2012-048.note: PLOS ONE 2019 verified: 10.8% of all-cause veteran amputees used multi-DOF powered devices; cited 46% and 22% are prior-literature figures. Still above 5% and long routine. Hit.

health-2012-049.note: Ekso 2022 release (SEC): 100 devices booked, $12.9M revenue; ReWalk and others cleared. Niche routine use = partial.

health-2012-050.note: Science Advances 2025 and VCU 2023: olfactory prostheses at prototype or first-human-test stage. No real use by 2025 = miss.

health-2012-051.note: NIDCD verified: ~736,900 cochlear implants worldwide by Dec 2019 (118,100 US adults, 65,000 children); capture interpretation names cochlear implants. Hit.
